name: Pancakes
ingredients: a little oil for the pan
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk the milk, egg, and melted butter separately, then stir into the dry ingredients just until combined. Small lumps are fine.
Lightly oil a skillet and heat over medium heat. Add small portions of batter, leaving room to spread.
Cook until bubbles appear and the edges look set, about 2–3 minutes. Flip and cook about 1–2 minutes more, until cooked through. Repeat in batches.

name: Scrambled eggs
steps: Beat the eggs with a little salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat.
Add the eggs and gently move them around with a spatula, folding as they set.
Cook until the eggs are set with no runny liquid, then serve immediately.

name: Grilled cheese
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Place the cheese between the bread slices, with the buttered sides facing out.
Cook in a skillet over medium-low heat for about 3–4 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese melts. Lower the heat if the bread browns too quickly.

name: White rice
steps: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs mostly clear.
Combine the rice, water, and salt in a saucepan with a tight lid. If your rice package gives a different water ratio, follow the package.
Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat to low. Simmer about 15–18 minutes without lifting the lid, until the water is absorbed and rice is tender.
Remove from the heat and leave covered for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

name: Tomato pasta
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Salt it, add the pasta, and cook according to its package directions.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a saucepan over medium-low heat. Stir in the garlic for about 30 seconds without browning it.
Add the tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Simmer gently for 10–15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Reserve a little pasta water, drain the pasta, and toss with the sauce. Add a splash of the reserved water if needed.

name: Oatmeal
steps: Combine the oats, water or milk, and salt in a small saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook over low heat for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until creamy. Follow the package if using a different type of oats.
Let stand for a minute, then add optional fruit or sweetener.

name: Mashed potatoes
ingredients: potatoes, peeled and cut into even chunks
steps: Put the potatoes in a saucepan, cover with cold water, and add a little salt.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for about 15–20 minutes, until a fork slides through easily.
Drain well and return to the warm pan off the heat for a minute to let steam escape.
Mash with the butter, then gradually stir in the warm milk. Season to taste; avoid overmixing.

name: Roasted potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C / 425°F.
Dry the potato pieces, then toss with the oil, salt, and optional paprika.
Spread in a single layer on a baking tray, leaving space between pieces. Use more trays for larger batches.
Roast for 30–40 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and tender when pierced.

name: Cheese quesadilla
steps: Sprinkle the cheese over half of the tortilla and fold the other half over it.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-low heat.
Cook the folded tortilla for about 2–3 minutes per side, until crisp and the cheese is melted.
Let cool slightly, then cut into wedges.

name: Banana smoothie
steps: Peel the banana and break it into pieces.
Put all ingredients in a blender, secure the lid, and blend until smooth.
Add a little more liquid if needed and serve immediately.

name: Garlic bread
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C / 400°F.
Mix the butter, garlic, and optional parsley, then spread over the bread.
Place on a baking tray and bake for 8–10 minutes, until the edges are crisp. Watch closely near the end.

name: Bean tacos
ingredients: canned black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Warm the oil in a skillet over medium heat, then add the beans, cumin, and water.
Simmer for about 5 minutes, stirring and lightly mashing some beans, until hot and thickened.
Warm the tortillas according to their package directions.
Fill with beans, salsa, and optional lettuce, then serve.
